title: Not as advertised, very low quality
text: Not as advertised, very low quality. I bought these bc the picture makes them look like pure stainless steel/high quality. The garbage I got was a different color, very scratched up, and affixes not magnetically- but using 3M tape. Who would want to put that in their sink? Will be returning immediately. Stay away.

product_metadata.title: SENLIXIN Sponge Holder Self Adhesive Sponge Holder for Kitchen Sink Caddy Stainless Steel Rust Proof Waterproof Quick Drying (A-Silver)
features: ✔ CREATIVE SPONGE HOLDER - The Sponge Holder hollow design allows water to drain, sponge dries quickly in the sink without leaving outside messes.

✔ HIGH QUALITY MATERIAL - The rustproof waterproof and powerful sponge holder is made of high quality stainless steel. Powerful adhesive can hold 8 lbs in daily use, more durable and stronger than suction cup.

✔ EASY TO INSTALL - Sponge holder uses self-adhesive method no drilling, not hurt wall, keep the sink dry and clean before sticking. then tear off the paper on the back of the sponge holder stainless, and paste it in the desired place, durable, use for a long time!
✔ SPACE SAVING DESIGN - The sponge holder helps you save more storage space of kitchen, especially using as an in-sink holder for sponge and sink stopper, makes your kitchen sink look more organized.
✔ WIDE APPLICATION - Using it in the holder kitchen sink, bathroom, and anywhere you want. You can use it to hang sponge, dishcloth, sink stopper, spatula, brush, small pot lid and so on.
